user.title: Connect PulsHealth
user.description: Connect to your read-only PulsHealth product API, not the marketing site, viewer, ingest endpoint, or MCP endpoint. Leave Account UUID blank to select and pin the server default account.

reauth_confirm.title: Update PulsHealth token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the replacement read-only product API token.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to read the selected account. Check the API URL, connectivity, and multi-user access.
error.invalid_auth: The product API rejected the token.
error.invalid_input: Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL and optional account UUID.

abort.already_configured: This server and account are already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The product API token was updated.
